page.layout: One page of text in a single column, no marginal notes. Running head "VITA" centred at the top, page number "78" at the top left. Catchword "rum" at the lower right.

main_text.p: tritio, sibi duram videri affirmat, atque, cum, qui sibi diceret, se propter Deum non pœnitere, non aufurum absolvere: & hanc Doctrinam etiam Judæorum Testimoniis confirmat, qui in hoc cum prisci s Ecclesiæ Patribus consentiunt, quòd omnes actiones nostras amoris divini causa faciendas existiment, atque inprimis pœnitentiam, aliàs hanc non fore validam.

Præterea multis iisque evidentissimis Patrum & Conciliorum testimoniis, maximè autoritate Cypriani, probat, diaconos olim in Ecclesia Latina eorum Confessiones, qui in extremo erant vitæ periculo audivisse, & pœnitentes reconciliasse, addit, verba Cypriani eo loco non posse explicari de absolutione ab Excommunicatione ; verùm intelligenda de absolutione à peccatis, quam statim comitabatur Eucharistiæ[?] Communistiæ ; quam etiam absolvendi à peccatis potestatem & Confessiones audiendi ad Laicos extendit eodem modo, quo hodiernis temporibus & ipsi in casu necessitatis infantes ex omnium Theolo-

page.notes: Catchword "rum" completes the hyphenated word "Theolo-rum" at the foot. "Eucharistiæ" is uncertain in the scan (ligature at the end of the word) and is marked [?]. Printed forms kept as they stand: "Cypriani", "aufurum", "Doctrinam". Spelling "qvi/qvod/qvam" changed to "qui/quod/quam" for u/v. Long s printed as s throughout.
